teaching_hospitals: Servicio de Salud Araucanía Sur — Red Asistencial de la Provincia de Cautín (UCT confirms this clinical-training network but does not name individual hospitals)

hiring.positions_note: 3 academic posts open today: 115/2026 Academic, Commercial Engineering (closes 30 September); 110/2026 Academic, Kinesiology (closes 21 September); and 107/2026 Academic, Industrial Processes (closes 21 September). No Medicine or Internal Medicine academic post is open today.
hiring.requires_chilean_title_note: No published requirement found for Chilean nationality or revalidación of a foreign degree. The posts require legalised copies of degrees/certificates. For foreign candidates, the stated rule is: «deben contar con todos sus documentos legales al día», including work visa, residence permit and Chilean identity card; without them, application and/or appointment is barred.

international.notes: UCT has a Dirección de Relaciones Internacionales with academic-mobility procedures. Medicine’s public curriculum includes a course titled “Inglés Aplicado a las Ciencias de la Salud”, but UCT does not state that any medical subject is delivered in English.

profile_paragraphs: Medicine is housed in UCT’s Facultad de Ciencias de la Salud, created in 2017. The Medicina programme began admissions in 2024; its current published curriculum is a full-time, 14-semester Médico/a Cirujano/a degree.

UCT’s confirmed clinical-training agreement is with Servicio de Salud Araucanía Sur. It opens establishments in the Cautín provincial care network to Medicine and other health students, but the university announcement does not identify individual hospitals.

UCT inaugurated its Hospital de Simulación in 2025 at Campus Nuestra Señora de Lourdes. The facility is used for teaching, research and high-complexity clinical training rather than being a patient-care teaching hospital.

For a rheumatologist, this is a very new medical school. UCT’s official material did not identify a UCT rheumatology unit or a rheumatology specialty/beca; its first doctoral programme in the faculty began in 2026.

The live vacancies page has three academic roles, including one in musculoskeletal kinesiology, but none in Medicine or Internal Medicine. A foreign applicant must already have Chilean work/residence documentation under the published vacancy rule.
